description: Experiment queue the run belongs to.
Unique training run (join key to run_parameters_*.csv and the success dataset). One run per bundle: the BEST training seed by mean success_fraction in success_rollouts_*.csv.
Observation/sensor bundle (compared policy axis): baseline, proprio.target, proprio.delta, force.magnitude. The blind 'none' bundle is excluded.
Training seed of this run (the best seed for its bundle).

JAX PRNGKey seed used for this evaluation rollout (0..7). NOTE: this is an independent reset stream, NOT the shared eval RNG index used by success_rollouts_*/detailed_rollouts_* — rollout_seed values are comparable ACROSS bundles here (same seed = same reset) but not to the other datasets.
Timestep within the rollout (0-based; 0..119 downwards, 0..79 pinch_sinusoid).
Total cube-hand contact force = sum of the per-finger contact-force magnitudes this step.
mujoco_playground commit used to roll out the policy. HEAD 3682863 for all runs here (pinch_sinusoid uses queue 142357, whose force.magnitude obs spec matches HEAD).
Per-fingertip contact-force magnitude vs the cube (raw Newtons) for fingertips rl_dg_1..rl_dg_5, read from the *_tip_cube_force sensors (env obs divides these by _TIP_FORCE_SCALE=10).
Thumb contact-force magnitude = sum of its two geom sensors (rl_dg_1_tip + rl_dg_1_tip_2 cube_force). The tip_2 pad geom reads ~0 by design.
Index contact-force magnitude = sum of its two geom sensors (rl_dg_2_tip + rl_dg_2_tip_2 cube_force).
